purpose: Require Level 3 to verify that the encouraging Phase 2B source twitch transfers to chamber-realized stress and pressure morphology without hiding scale errors behind Tref rescaling or free gain.

phase2bContext.interpretation: Encouraging source-stress timing and width, but not yet evidence that chamber-realized stress/pressure scale is correct.

requiredLevel3Checks.description: Compare Phase 2B source stress around 37 kPa with chamber-realized stress expected around 10-16 kPa under the accepted kinematics/homogenization path.
Verify that the same source-stress trace can produce approximately 120 mmHg-class loaded pressure morphology under the Level 3 minimal chamber without Tref rescaling or free pressure gain.
Reject any Level 3 pass that requires Tref rescaling, hidden homogenization multiplier, geomChi-like pressure gain, arbitrary tension filter, or morphology-only viscosity.

Compare the Phase 2B source twitch peak to the Land 2017 intact-human reference/expected scale at the same lambda/Ca condition to catch nominal/Cauchy or constant-factor mistakes before calibration can hide them.

notes: The 10-16 kPa and 120 mmHg-class values are planning targets and must be finalized in versioned target packs before becoming acceptance thresholds.
This gate is not a request to tune Tref. It is a transfer and scale-consistency check.
